# Recorded late re-seals for the seals-move-with-their-tree gate.
#
# Each line records one seal that landed one commit after the tree it
# measures, in a history that is already shared and cannot be rewritten:
#
#   <seal_diff_digest> <seal> <tree> <reason>
#
# The digest keys the seal transition (path, mode and blob id before and
# after), not the commit SHA. Copy it from the gate's report; never compute
# it by hand. A line that does not parse, names a pair that is not a seal and
# its tree, or carries a reason shorter than 20 characters fails the gate.
